contracts: The exact C# case runs actual entry-only composition with temporary metadata and exercises its duty through the real existing HTTP/service entrypoint, checking returned outcome and ordinary-production side effects. Python must invoke the exact C# test through dotnet test and validate one fresh TRX result plus actual product observations. Compile failures, missing APIs/types/tests, skips, missing/invalid TRX or timeout are harness failures, never expected-red. All owners are existing public entrypoint files; do not pre-seed a missing C# production class to obtain RED. No product runtime success is claimed by this plan.
